name: leaddesk
description: Open-source outreach CRM — import leads from Google Maps, run WhatsApp & email campaigns, manage clients.
author: PaoloTheDev (https://paoloothedev.com)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && rm -rf server/public && cp -r client/dist server/public
scripts.setup: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
